correctness.rationale: The parity split is exhaustive. Even k is impossible modulo 8 apart from three explicitly checked low-an values. For odd k>=3, T=(y^k+1)/(y+1) is odd and divides n, so T<=n; T>3y^(k-1)/4 yields y^k<(4n/3)^(3/2), contradicting the lower bound on n2^(an)-1. Boundary n=1,2 is handled directly.
